sqlMap.select: SELECT A.DEPOY_QUEUE_ID qid,(SELECT C.NAME FROM T_CITY_MILITARY C WHERE CITY_MILITARY_ID=A.CITY_MILITARY_ID) AS name,B.POSX AS posX,B.POSY posY,A.TYPE AS type,A.FINISH_TIME AS finishTime FROM T_DEPOY_QUEUE A , T_MAP B WHERE CITY_ID=#cityID# AND A.MAP_ID=B.MAP_ID UNION ALL SELECT SPY_QUEUE_ID ,'侦察' , POSX ,POSY ,1,FINISH_TIME FROM T_SPY_QUEUE WHERE CITY_ID=#cityID#

SELECT DEPOY_QUEUE_ID AS depoyQueueID,C.NAME AS militaryName,D.NAME AS heroName,D.LEVEL AS level, B.POSX AS posX,B.POSY AS posY, A.TYPE AS type,FINISH_TIME AS finishTime ,C.ARMY1 AS army1,C.ARMY2 AS army2,C.ARMY3 AS army3,ARMY4 AS army4,ARMY5 AS army5,ARMY6 AS army6,ARMY7 AS army7,ARMY8 AS army8 FROM T_DEPOY_QUEUE A,T_MAP B,T_CITY_MILITARY C,T_CITY_HERO D WHERE A.MAP_ID=B.MAP_ID AND A.CITY_MILITARY_ID=C.CITY_MILITARY_ID AND C.CITY_HERO_ID=D.CITY_HERO_ID AND DEPOY_QUEUE_ID=#depoyQueueID#

SELECT DQ.DEPOY_QUEUE_ID AS depoyQueueID, DQ.CITY_ID AS cityID, DQ.CITY_MILITARY_ID AS cityMilitaryID, DQ.MAP_ID AS mapID, DQ.TYPE AS type, DQ.REMARK AS remark, DQ.FINISH_TIME AS finishTime FROM T_DEPOY_QUEUE DQ, T_MAP M, T_CITY_MILITARY CM WHERE CM.CITY_ID!=#cityID# AND CM.CITY_MILITARY_ID=DQ.CITY_MILITARY_ID AND M.MAP_ID=DQ.MAP_ID AND M.TYPE=1 AND M.TARGET_ID=#cityID#
